purpose: Cover US-17502: computeReadiness folds levels.intentComplete and levels.readyToBuild plus personas.productOwner and personas.engineer from stages[].checks[]; the folds are additive and no file under rcf/ is written (ADR-4126).
title: Two readiness levels folded on one object

testCases.description: A tree where every productOwner check is ok and at least one engineer check fails has levels.intentComplete.ok true and levels.readyToBuild.ok false.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-1): PO ok + engineer failing => L1 ok, L2 not ok

testCases.description: A tree where freezeable is true has levels.readyToBuild.ok true and levels.intentComplete.ok true.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness: freezeable is true on a well-formed tree (every stage passed / notApplicable)

testCases.description: A tree where brief:profile fails has levels.intentComplete.ok false and a single blocker for D1 brief:profile with persona productOwner and ids profile:surface and profile:register.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-3): brief:profile failing yields L1 blocker and PO next action

testCases.description: An engineer failure inside a D3 stage acknowledged at the current hash is absent from levels.readyToBuild.blockedBy.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-4): acknowledged D3 engineer failure is absent from readyToBuild.blockedBy

testCases.description: personas.productOwner.blockers deep-equals levels.intentComplete.blockedBy and levels.readyToBuild.nextAction deep-equals nextAction.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-5): personas.productOwner.blockers deep-equals L1 blockedBy; readyToBuild.nextAction equals nextAction

testCases.description: With engineer failures in D2 and D4 and a PO failure in D4 only, personas.productOwner.nextAction names D4 and personas.engineer.nextAction names D2.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-6): PO-nextAction prefers first PO-failing stage; engineer-nextAction prefers first engineer-failing stage

testCases.description: readiness cli (text and --json) does not create or modify any file under rcf/; the existing readiness cli test suite TS-217 continues to pass unchanged.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17502-7 rcf/ tree is byte-stable across a readiness run (no mutation)

testCases.description: Every 0.28.4 top-level field (tree, delta, stages, nextAction, coverage, decisions, freezeable) is present on the 0.29.0 result with its 0.28.4 type.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126, AC-17502-8): 0.28.4 fields present with their types
